events.name: Dragon Lights 2026 Season Pass
events.description:
Step into Dragon Lights Reno 2026: Many Worlds Aglow, running October 2 – November 29 at the Wilbur D. May Arboretum and Botanic Garden. Wander through three dazzling zones — Desert World, Pre-historic World, and Asian Culture — each brought to life with illuminated lantern art. New this year, don't miss the towering Cactus Man in Desert World, a fire-spitting T-Rex in Pre-historic World, and galloping horses lighting up Asian Culture. Grab your tickets and experience a world aglow like never before.

Get unlimited visits to Dragon Lights Reno for the entire festival season with this Season Pass. The pass is good for one person only. Young children of age 2 and under are free to attend the event.
